summary: In this excerpt from Book 14, the narrator, who is secretly the Secret Avenger, accepts an offer from a man to stay at his apartment after biking with him through cold weather. She plans to search his phone and computer and copy his hard drive, perhaps by swapping their wine glasses so she can drug or outwit him, but he sits drinking beer while she gets a glass of wine instead. The scene builds tension as she inspects the cluttered apartment, listens to records, and realizes her plan is faltering.
one_line: The Secret Avenger accepts a stranger's invitation to his apartment, planning to search his phone and computer, but her plan begins to unravel.
key_facts: The narrator accepts an invitation to stay on the couch of a man's apartment after biking with him in cold weather.
The narrator had a plan to wait until the man passed out, then look at both of his phones, find his computer, and copy his hard drive.
The narrator planned to swap their wine glasses when the man was not looking.
The man lives in a two-story rental house, reached by a flight of wooden stairs on the side of the building.
The narrator locks her bike to the fence beside the staircase before following him up the steps.
The apartment smells like an ash tray that hadn't been washed in about ten years.
The apartment contains a ratty couch, a desk piled with papers and unopened junk mail, a bed in one corner, and shelves with a fancy turntable and many records.
The narrator keeps her boots on because the carpet is disgusting and she may need to make a run for it.
The man hands the narrator a glass of wine and describes it as a little sweet with a spicy nip, very sophisticated.
The man drinks a beer rather than wine, saying he will save the wine all for her.
The narrator refers to herself as the Secret Avenger when building up her courage.
The man had just picked up a new album from a great local band and insisted she hear it on vinyl, which he said sounds better than digital.
The man's phone may be official government equipment on loan from the FBI, according to the narrator's guess.

entities.name: Secret Avenger
entities.role: Alias the narrator uses for herself, which she invokes to build her courage for the plan.

entities.name: Charlie
entities.role: The Secret Avenger's client, whose voice pitch the man once used.

entities.name: FBI
entities.role: Federal agency the narrator suspects may have loaned the man's phone.
